abilities.title_en: Melee Calibration Mode: {{var_1}} chance to Evade the opponent's Basic Melee Attacks.
abilities.desc_zh: 近战校准模式：{{var_1}} 几率躲避对手的基本近战攻击。
abilities.desc_en: Melee Calibration Mode: {{var_1}} chance to Evade the opponent's Basic Melee Attacks.

abilities.title_en: Ranged Calibration Mode: {{var_2}} chance to Evade the opponent's Basic Ranged Attacks.
abilities.desc_zh: 远程校准模式：{{var_2}} 几率躲避对手的基本远程攻击。
abilities.desc_en: Ranged Calibration Mode: {{var_2}} chance to Evade the opponent's Basic Ranged Attacks.

abilities.title_en: Passive: Bumblebee is furious when his teammates are hurt, granting him +{{var_3}} Attack per fallen teammate for {{var_4}} at the start of the fight.
abilities.desc_zh: 被动：当队友受伤时，大黄蜂会勃然大怒，在战斗开始时，每倒下的队友，他都会获得 +{{var_3}} 攻击力。
abilities.desc_en: Passive: Bumblebee is furious when his teammates are hurt, granting him +{{var_3}} Attack per fallen teammate for {{var_4}} at the start of the fight.

abilities.title_en: When Knocking Down Opponents: Gains a permanent Attack Buff, increasing Attack by {{var_5}}. The bigger the size of the opponent, the larger the Attack bonus. (Max: 15 stacks)
abilities.desc_zh: 击倒对手时：获得永久攻击增益，攻击力增加 {{var_5}}。对手的体型越大，攻击加值就越大。 （最多：15 叠）
abilities.desc_en: When Knocking Down Opponents: Gains a permanent Attack Buff, increasing Attack by {{var_5}}. The bigger the size of the opponent, the larger the Attack bonus. (Max: 15 stacks)

abilities.desc_zh: 大黄蜂在远程和近战校准模式之间切换得更快。此外，大黄蜂的敏捷性使他在躲避传入的近战攻击后获得 {{var_7}} 的临时 {{var_6}} 攻击增益。
abilities.desc_en:
Alacrity
Bumblebee switches between his Ranged and Melee Calibration modes faster. Additionally, Bumblebee's agility grants him a temporary {{var_6}} Attack Buff for {{var_7}} after Dodging an incoming Melee Attack.

abilities.desc_zh: 他可能像蝴蝶一样漂浮，但他像大黄蜂一样蜇人。
abilities.desc_en: Buzz Kick - He may float like a butterfly, but he stings like a Bumblebee.

abilities.desc_zh: (+v8.0) 每次命中都有 {{var_8}} 几率造成装甲破坏，移除敌方装甲并为 {{var_10}} 应用 {{var_9}} 装甲减少。
abilities.desc_en: (+v8.0) Each hit has a {{var_8}} chance to inflict an Armor Break, removing enemy Armor and applying {{var_9}} Armor reduction for {{var_10}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 在踢腿和能量爆炸之间，你仍然可以看到他眼中年轻的喜悦。
abilities.desc_en: Bug Shot - You can still see the youthful joy in his eyes between the kicks and energy blasts.

abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_19}}~{{var_20}} 汽车人攻击评级。 +{{var_21}}~{{var_22}} 突袭中汽车人的减益伤害。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_19}}~{{var_20}} Attack Rating for Autobots. +{{var_21}}~{{var_22}} Debuff damage for Autobots in Raids.

abilities.desc_zh: 战斗开始时修复基地生命值的{{var_25}}~{{var_26}}。 +{{var_27}}~{{var_28}} 突袭中的额外修复。
abilities.desc_en: {{var_25}}~{{var_26}} of base Health Repaired at the start of the fight. +{{var_27}}~{{var_28}} extra Repair in Raids.

abilities.desc_zh: {{var_29}}~{{var_30}} 在使用特殊 2 或 3 击球时激活对手能力的可能性较小。
abilities.desc_en: {{var_29}}~{{var_30}} less likely to activate the opponent's abilities when hitting with Special 2 or 3.

abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_31}}~{{var_32}} 躲避对手攻击时进行下一次攻击。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_31}}~{{var_32}} Attack on the next hit when dodging the Opponent's attacks.

abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_33}}~{{var_34}} 汽车人装甲以及+{{var_35}}~{{var_36}} 单人任务中的近战伤害。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_33}}~{{var_34}} Armor for Autobots as well as +{{var_35}}~{{var_36}} Melee Damage in Solo Missions.
